name: Gardena Autopilot Agent
description: Policy-gated AI agent for Mantle RWA farming. It analyzes USDY and mETH yield routes, recommends bounded strategy moves, writes transparent decision logs, and exposes proof data for Gardena users.

capabilities.description: Ranks Mantle RWA opportunities across USDY, mETH, and dynamic USDY/mETH routes.
Applies deterministic user guardrails before approving rebalance decisions.
Anchors approved or blocked decisions through the DecisionLog contract on Mantle Sepolia.
Uses an OpenAI-compatible LLM node for market explanation while keeping execution bounded by deterministic policy checks.

authentication.description: Requests should be authenticated with a user wallet or service-side relayer policy.

model: OpenAI-compatible LLM advisor with deterministic fallback
